events.title: Old Dominion stock holds near $205 after earnings beat
events.summary: Old Dominion Freight Line's stock is holding near $205 after the company reported a quarterly EPS beat of $1.68 and revenue of $1.55 billion, surpassing consensus estimates. Despite the strong earnings, the stock is trading below its 50-day and 200-day moving averages, and analysts maintain a "Hold" consensus with an average price target of $226.55. The company also declared a quarterly dividend of $0.29 per share.

articles.headline: Old Dominion stock holds near $205 after earnings beat

events.title: Are Phillips 66 (PSX) and Marathon Petroleum Corporation (MPC) Still Attractive After the $180 Billion Deal Collapse?
events.summary: Reports surfaced on August 14th that refining giants Phillips 66 (PSX) and Marathon Petroleum Corporation (MPC) held preliminary talks earlier this year regarding a potential $180 billion mega-merger. The deal ultimately collapsed, largely due to regulatory hurdles, and investors are now evaluating each company's independent performance. Both companies delivered strong Q2 2026 financial results, benefiting from expanding crack spreads and robust demand, but present different bull and bear cases for investors.

articles.headline: Are Phillips 66 (PSX) and Marathon Petroleum Corporation (MPC) Still Attractive After the $180 Billion Deal Collapse?

events.title: Charter Communications Finalizes Mergers with Liberty Broadband and Cox Enterprises
events.summary: Charter Communications has completed its merger with Liberty Broadband Corporation and an acquisition transaction with Cox Enterprises, Inc., as disclosed in a recent Form 8-K filing. The Liberty merger resulted in a net reduction of approximately 4.7 million Charter Class A shares outstanding, while the Cox deal involved $3.5 billion in cash payments, issuance of convertible preferred units, and assumption of about $12 billion in Cox debt. These transactions significantly impact Charter's capital structure and operational scope.

articles.headline: Charter Communications Finalizes Mergers with Liberty Broadband and Cox Enterprises

events.title: Republic Services (NYSE:RSG) Major Shareholder Cascade Investment, L.L.C. Acquires 200,125 Shares of Stock
events.summary: Cascade Investment, L.L.C., a major shareholder in Republic Services (NYSE:RSG), recently acquired an additional 200,125 shares of the company's stock for approximately $43.6 million. This purchase is part of several large acquisitions made by Cascade Investment, bringing their total holdings to over 112.2 million shares. The acquisition follows Republic Services' strong quarterly results, which exceeded analyst expectations, and the company's decision to increase its quarterly dividend.

articles.headline: Republic Services (NYSE:RSG) Major Shareholder Cascade Investment, L.L.C. Acquires 200,125 Shares of Stock

events.title: Targa Resources Corp. announces 20-Year agreements with ExxonMobil
events.summary: Targa Resources Corp. announced new 20-year integrated midstream agreements with ExxonMobil subsidiaries for natural gas gathering, processing, treating, and liquid fractionation services in the Permian Basin. To support this, Targa plans to construct three new natural gas processing plants (Wrangler, Ranger, Ranger II) in the Delaware Basin, adding 825 MMcf/d capacity by H1 2028, and a 70-mile Bull Run II natural gas pipeline, increasing its 2026 growth capital estimate to $5 billion. These agreements significantly expand Targa's strategic relationship with ExxonMobil and are expected to drive substantial long-term volume growth and enhance Targa's financial outlook.

articles.headline: Targa Resources Corp. announces 20-Year agreements with ExxonMobil

events.title: Xcel Energy stock holds steady as Colorado approves 4.77% electric rate hike
events.summary: Xcel Energy's stock remained stable after Colorado regulators approved a 4.77% electric rate increase, which will raise residential bills by $5 per month and add $157 million in annual revenue for the utility. This decision, following nine months of deliberation, provides a fresh revenue tailwind and reinforces the company's regulated earnings visibility, aligning with its $50.28 billion market capitalization and an average analyst target of $92.41. The utility continues to balance infrastructure investments and renewable integration with consumer affordability and regulatory scrutiny.

articles.headline: Xcel Energy stock holds steady as Colorado approves 4.77% electric rate hike

events.title: Ross Stores earned $2.66 a share, including a roughly 60-cent tariff refund
events.summary: Ross Stores reported strong second-quarter 2026 results with sales up 13% to $6.26 billion and EPS of $2.66, which included a $0.60 benefit from tariff refunds. The company raised its full-year 2026 EPS guidance to $8.61–$8.77 and increased its store opening plan to 115 new locations. Despite a moderate negative market reaction to the news, Ross Stores highlighted its strong performance and momentum heading into the second half of the year.

articles.headline: Ross Stores earned $2.66 a share, including a roughly 60-cent tariff refund

events.title: Delta Is Quietly Cutting Its Las Vegas Routes To Rebuild The Hub Around Premium Flyers
events.summary: Delta Air Lines has strategically cut several Las Vegas routes, including nonstop service from Sacramento and San Jose, to focus on higher-yield premium flyers. This move, driven by a 7% decline in Las Vegas tourism in early 2025 and a desire to avoid competing with budget carriers on low-margin routes, signifies Delta's pivot from a volume-based to a yield-based business model. The airline is expanding premium cabin offerings like Premium Select on transcontinental routes, aiming to attract affluent travelers and establish Las Vegas as a premium spoke in its network, ensuring higher revenue per seat despite potentially fewer overall flights.

articles.headline: Delta Is Quietly Cutting Its Las Vegas Routes To Rebuild The Hub Around Premium Flyers

events.title: Catch up: Where the proposed $67B Dominion-NextEra merger stands 3 months later
events.summary: Three months after the proposed $67 billion merger between NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy was announced, it is facing intense regulatory scrutiny in Virginia. Governor Abigail Spanberger, state lawmakers, experts, and numerous residents are raising concerns, particularly regarding a potential conflict of interest involving the State Corporation Commission's lead reviewer and the impact on ratepayers. The SCC is expected to decide on the merger's terms in January.

articles.headline: Catch up: Where the proposed $67B Dominion-NextEra merger stands 3 months later

events.title: Norfolk Southern stock holds firm as regulators restart review of Union Pacific merger
events.summary: Norfolk Southern stock is trading near its consensus price target as the Surface Transportation Board resumes its review of the proposed merger with Union Pacific. This review, expected to last until at least May 2027, introduces both uncertainty and potential opportunities for investors. The company's strong fundamentals, including consistent dividends and exceeding earnings estimates, support its current valuation amidst the lengthy regulatory process.

articles.headline: Norfolk Southern stock holds firm as regulators restart review of Union Pacific merger

events.title: Ford Stock Slips As Trade Fears And Sales Drop Rattle Traders
events.summary: Ford Motor Company (F) stock slipped by 3.48% due to concerns over weakening EV demand, a 10.2% drop in July U.S. vehicle sales, and potential increased costs from USMCA revisions. The CEO also warned about impending competition from Chinese automakers in the U.S. market. Analysts suggest that while the company has strong cash flow, it faces significant challenges with negative margins and policy uncertainties, making it a battleground stock for traders.

articles.headline: Ford Stock Slips As Trade Fears And Sales Drop Rattle Traders

events.title: Sempra stock holds in the mid-$80s as investors weigh bond issuance and steady utility earnings
events.summary: Sempra Inc. stock is trading in the mid-$80s as investors evaluate the company's reaffirmed earnings guidance and its recent long-term bond issuance. Analysts maintain a "moderate buy" rating with a consensus price target of $103.92, suggesting potential upside despite interest-rate sensitivities. The company's strategy involves matching long-lived assets with long-term funding to support grid modernization and gas infrastructure expansion, aiming for predictable earnings growth through regulated returns.

articles.headline: Sempra stock holds in the mid-$80s as investors weigh bond issuance and steady utility earnings

events.title: Ford Drops 4% as Bronco Pickup Rally Fades, Tesla Slips, General Motors Inches Higher: What's Behind the Auto Stock Differential?
events.summary: Ford shares dropped 4% after a rally based on unconfirmed Bronco product reports faded, while General Motors gained 1%, indicating a company-specific reversal for Ford rather than a sector trend. Tesla also slipped 2% due to unrelated AI infrastructure capital-spending pressures. Investors are advised to exercise patience with Ford and monitor its upcoming Bronco recall notification on August 24.

articles.headline: Ford Drops 4% as Bronco Pickup Rally Fades, Tesla Slips, General Motors Inches Higher: What's Behind the Auto Stock Differential?

events.title: Arch Capital Group stock holds firm after a July 28 earnings beat
events.summary: Arch Capital Group (ACGL) stock maintained its position at $98.53 after beating second-quarter 2026 earnings and revenue estimates. The insurer reported $2.56 EPS and $4.67 billion in revenue, surpassing analyst consensus. Despite a slight year-over-year EPS decline, the company's strong net margin, return on equity, and $800 million stock repurchase reinforce its steady performance in specialty insurance, reinsurance, and mortgage insurance.

articles.headline: Arch Capital Group stock holds firm after a July 28 earnings beat

events.title: Vulcan Materials stock rises on a $2.59 earnings beat
events.summary: Vulcan Materials (VMC) shares rose after the company reported quarterly EPS of $2.59, beating consensus estimates of $2.46, and revenue of $2.16 billion. The company reaffirmed its 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance of $2.4 billion to $2.6 billion. The stock trades with a market capitalization of $35.83 billion, and its performance is closely tied to aggregate pricing, shipment volumes, and construction demand.

articles.headline: Vulcan Materials stock rises on a $2.59 earnings beat

events.title: General Electric Co Stock (GE) Moved Down by 3.20% on Aug 20: What Signal Does It Send?
events.summary: General Electric Co (GE) stock dropped by 3.20% on August 20th due to profit-taking after a sustained rally and persistent operational and cost pressures within the aerospace manufacturing environment. Despite strong demand, supply chain bottlenecks, rising expenses, and valuation recalibrations contributed to the decline. Technical indicators show neutral MACD and RSI but an oversold Williams %R, while analysts maintain "Buy" ratings with an average price target of $399.21.

articles.headline: General Electric Co Stock (GE) Moved Down by 3.20% on Aug 20: What Signal Does It Send?

events.title: Deere Stock Soars After Construction Unit Drives Earnings Beat
events.summary: Deere & Co. shares surged after the company's fiscal third-quarter results, driven by its construction and forestry business, beat analyst expectations. The company also raised the lower end of its full-year earnings guidance. Despite a revenue decline in its largest unit, strong growth in construction and forestry, along with double-digit sales growth in small agriculture and turf, contributed to the positive performance.

articles.headline: Deere Stock Soars After Construction Unit Drives Earnings Beat

events.title: Cardano Surges 5.66% on Macro Shocks and Project News
events.summary: Cardano (ADA) experienced a 5.66% surge due to a combination of macro-economic factors, project-specific news, and a bullish short-term technical setup. A US Treasury announcement regarding increased long-term bond buybacks triggered a broad crypto market rally and a significant short squeeze. This macro shift, coupled with Cardano's new IBC testnet connection to Injective and the initiation of its Dijkstra network upgrade, provided strong catalysts for ADA's price movement.

articles.headline: Cardano Surges 5.66% on Macro Shocks and Project News

events.title: Columbus Circle Capital Corp II Signs $800M Merger Agreement with Elroy Air
events.summary: Columbus Circle Capital Corp II (NASDAQ: CMIIU, CMII, CMIIW) has entered into a definitive $800 million merger agreement with Elroy Air, Inc., a developer of autonomous cargo aircraft. The SPAC aims to transform from a shell company into an operating business in the autonomous aviation sector. The transaction will include the issuance of up to 11,000,000 additional shares as earnout consideration and is expected to be funded by the SPAC's $233.1 million trust account.

articles.headline: Columbus Circle Capital Corp II Signs $800M Merger Agreement with Elroy Air

events.title: SCC chair won’t recuse herself from NextEra-Dominion case
events.summary: State Corporation Commission Chair Kelsey A. Bagot has stated she will not recuse herself from the proposed $66.8 billion NextEra Energy-Dominion Energy merger proceedings. Bagot, who previously worked as a senior attorney for NextEra, asserted her duty to impartially discharge her duties and noted that her past work history with a regulated entity does not typically require recusal. The merger, which would create the world’s largest regulated electric utility, is expected to close in the second half of 2027 and is facing opposition in Virginia.

articles.headline: SCC chair won’t recuse herself from NextEra-Dominion case
